home.title: JSON to Table: Convert JSON to Excel & CSV Online
home.description: Paste JSON, preview structured rows instantly, fine-tune columns and filters, then export polished Excel or CSV files without sending your data anywhere.
home.workflowDesc: Paste, configure, export in one screen
home.privacyDesc: Data stays inside your browser session
home.structureDesc: Handles flat, wrapped, nested, and JSONL input
home.fastWorkspaceDesc: Built for large everyday API payloads with path detection, nested strategies, editable columns, and filterable preview tables.
home.privacyDetailsDesc: Every transformation runs in-browser. No upload pipeline, no server processing.
home.dataInputDesc: Paste raw JSON, load an example, or drop a local file.
home.structureSetupDesc: Choose the array path and define how nested data should expand.
home.previewFiltersDesc: Search, refine, and inspect the resulting table before export.
home.columnManagerDesc: Rename, show or hide columns, and adjust detected data types.
home.exportStudioDesc: Finalize CSV options or export a styled Excel workbook.
home.faqDesc: Understand the supported input structures, nested handling, and export options.
home.faqStep1Title: Step 1: Paste or Upload Your JSON Data
home.faqStep1Desc: Paste JSON directly into the text area, or use JSON Lines (JSONL). The tool accepts arrays, nested objects, and API-wrapped responses.
home.faqStep2Desc: Rename columns, reorder their meaning through type selection, hide unused fields, and add filter conditions to focus on matching rows.
home.faqStep3Title: Step 3: Download Excel or CSV File
home.faqStep3Desc: Export styled Excel files with formatting or generate CSV output with your preferred delimiter, header behavior, and BOM settings.
home.faqNestedTitle: Convert Nested JSON to Excel Without Coding
home.faqNestedDesc: Objects like {example} become columns {column} automatically. No manual transformation needed.
home.faqStrategiesTitle: Handle Array Fields with 4 Built-In Strategies
home.faqStrategiesDesc: Choose **Flatten**, **Stringify**, **Explode**, or **Multi-Sheet** depending on whether you want dot-notation columns, JSON text, extra rows, or separate worksheets.
home.faqCsvTitle: JSON to CSV: Custom Delimiters and UTF-8 BOM
home.faqCsvDesc: Export CSV with comma, semicolon, tab, or pipe delimiters. Include headers, enable UTF-8 BOM for Excel on Windows, and export only filtered rows when needed.
home.faqSafeDesc: All parsing, transformation, filtering, and export operations happen inside your browser. Your JSON data is never uploaded to a server or stored remotely.
home.faqStandardArraysDesc: Arrays of objects with flat or nested properties, such as {example}.
home.faqApiWrappersDesc: The tool detects paths such as {path} from wrapped payloads like {wrapped}.
home.faqJsonlDesc: One JSON object per line for logs or streams. JSONL is detected automatically and normalized into a table.

about.title: About JSON to Table
about.subtitle: A free, privacy-first tool for converting JSON data to Excel and CSV formats.
about.browserProcessingDesc: All JSON parsing, table generation, filtering, and file export runs entirely in your browser using JavaScript. No server-side processing is involved.
about.noAccountDesc: Open the website, paste your JSON, and download your file. No registration, no login, no data collection.
about.builtWithDesc: Vue 3, TypeScript, Vite, TanStack Table, TanStack Virtual, ExcelJS, Pinia, and UnoCSS. Open source libraries power the conversion engine; your data stays local.

privacy.title: Privacy Protection
privacy.body: All JSON parsing, transformation, and export happens in your browser. We will never see your data.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.desc: Have a question, suggestion, or found a bug? We would love to hear from you.
contact.emailDesc: For general inquiries, bug reports, or feature requests, send us an email. We typically respond within 24-48 hours.
contact.beforeContactDesc: JSON to Table is a 100% client-side tool. We do not have access to your data, nor can we recover lost conversions. If you are experiencing issues with a specific JSON file, please include a minimal sample that reproduces the problem.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.section1Desc: JSON to Table is designed with privacy as a core principle. All JSON parsing, table transformation, filtering, and export operations happen entirely within your web browser. Your data is never uploaded to, stored on, or processed by any server.
privacy.section2Title: 2. What Data We Do Not Collect
privacy.section2Desc: We do not collect, store, or have access to:
section2List: Any JSON data you paste, upload, or convert
Your browser history or browsing behavior
privacy.section3Desc: We use your browser's localStorage to remember your preferences (language selection and dark/light mode). This data stays on your device and is never transmitted to us or any third party. You can clear this data at any time through your browser settings.
privacy.section4Desc: We do not use tracking cookies, analytics services (such as Google Analytics), or advertising cookies. The only cookies or local storage items are those used for your interface preferences as described above.
privacy.section5Desc: JSON to Table does not integrate with any third-party services that process your data. The application is hosted on Cloudflare Pages, which may log basic access information (such as IP addresses) for security and performance purposes. This is standard CDN logging and is not linked to your conversion activities.
privacy.section6Desc: Because we do not collect or store your personal data, there is no data to access, modify, or delete on our servers. All your data remains under your control on your own device. You can clear all locally stored preferences at any time through your browser settings.
privacy.section7Desc: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.
privacy.section8Desc: If you have any questions about this privacy policy, please contact us at

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.section1Desc: Cookies are small text files that websites place on your computer or mobile device when you visit them. They are widely used to make websites work more efficiently and to provide information to the website owners.
cookies.section2Desc: JSON to Table takes a minimal approach to data storage. We do not use traditional HTTP cookies for tracking, analytics, or advertising. Instead, we use your browser's localStorage for a small set of essential preferences, as described below.
cookies.localePurpose: Remember your language preference (Chinese or English)
cookies.section5Title: 5. How to Manage or Clear Stored Data
cookies.section5Desc: You can clear all locally stored data at any time through your browser settings:
cookies.chrome: Chrome: Settings > Privacy and security > Clear browsing data
cookies.firefox: Firefox: Settings > Privacy & Security > Clear Data
cookies.safari: Safari: Preferences > Privacy > Manage Website Data
cookies.edge: Edge: Settings > Privacy, search, and services > Clear browsing data
cookies.section6Desc: If you have any questions about our cookie policy, please contact us at
